# Article Card

`editorial/article-card` &middot; content-level &middot; category: editorial

## Purpose

One article: image, category, linked title, excerpt, byline and a read link.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `article` | article |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Image, category, title, excerpt, byline and read link.
- **minimal**: Image, category and title only. Sets `showExcerpt: false`, `showMeta: false`, `showLink: false`.
- **headline**: Title, byline and read link, no excerpt. Sets `showExcerpt: false`.
- **centered**: Centered text. Sets `align: center`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `titleLevel` | one of `h3`, `h2`, `h4` | `"h3"` |
| `showExcerpt` | boolean | `true` |
| `showMeta` | boolean | `true` |
| `showLink` | boolean | `true` |
| `linkLabel` | text | `"Read the article"` |
| `imageRadius` | length | `"@theme.image.radius"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text and images honored. | Fine. The image is a real img with alt text. | Text swaps via dm-text where honored. Title link takes the dark link color. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('editorial/article-card', {
  "article": {
    "title": "How to care for linen so it lasts a decade",
    "excerpt": "Wash it cool, dry it slow and never iron it flat. Our care guide has everything you need.",
    "image": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/560x360/png?text=Care%20Guide",
      "alt": "A linen shirt drying on a line in the sun"
    },
    "href": "https://example.com/journal/caring-for-linen",
    "author": "Maya Chen",
    "date": "12 June",
    "category": "Care guide",
    "readTime": "4 min read"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "editorial/article-card",
  "data": {
```
